title: Fragrance is overpowering and headache producing; this is liquid free
text:
Fragrance is overpowering and headache producing; this is liquid free. This is totally not what I expected. First of all, I thought it was a liquid diffuser but I did not read the label correctly.  Secondly, the scent is so overpowering, that I have a headache as a result and the reeds are in a different room.

This comes with a small white loop which looks like a napkin ring. There are a total of six reeds which is equivalent to "two servings" with each serving of three reeds lasting up to 40 days. When the reeds lose their fragrance, throw them out and insert the next set.

I do not know if I am going to throw this out or not. Right now the fragrance has not dissipated after 24  hours. One more thing, when inserting the reeds into the holder, it is impossible not to touch them. My fingers felt irritated (burning) just from setting this up. I immediately washed my hands with soap and water. Since I have cats, I put this in a place far away from them. I attached a picture of the ingredients which has a skin irritation warning associated with it.

The only thing this has going for it is the stylishness of the diffuser with the reeds. Other than this, I hate this.
